answer: Require every agent to lock a scarce token bond before its votes count, and slash the bond when independent checks confirm a false claim. In an orchard market, a marble-sized stake can make influence costly without proving a person’s identity; a lotus badge alone carries no weight. To multiply Sybil votes, an attacker must acquire and risk a separate bond for each fake agent, tying up capital that honest participants can reclaim after compliant activity.
